## Two Estimates for the 1906 Earthquake

The 1906 earthquake has two magnitude estimates: 7.7 and 7.9, derived from different measurement approaches.

The 7.7 estimate came from seismic analysis using usable recordings from 12 of the 96 observatories studied. A USGS re-evaluation of geodetic measurements estimated the earthquake at 7.9, based on changes in angles and distances between benchmarks.

The estimates differ because they come from different ways of measuring earthquake size.
